 SITE VISIT 
A site visit is scheduled for 11/5/2026 at 1:00 pm Local Time at 3551 Combine St., Paso Robles, CA 93446. Please provide the name and phone number for all attendees at least two (2) days prior to Bruce Kane,  Bruce.CTR.Kane@faa.gov , Mobile: 817-300-6674. 
Information provided at the site visit, as well as answers to questions will not change/qualify the terms and conditions of the solicitation and specifications.  Terms remain unchanged unless the solicitation is amended in writing.  

 ************************************************************************************************************************************************** 

 The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is issuing Screening Information Request (SIR) Number 697DCK-27-R-00022, Design Renovation, System Support Center (SSC), 3551 Combine St., Paso Robles, CA, 93446 as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. 
 
OFFER SUBMISSION 
Send your offer to Linda.Hennequant@faa.gov. Reference provision L02 REQUIRED DOCUMENTS for specific submission  requirements. 
Please reference the Solicitation number in all correspondences to ensure prompt and proper processing. Emails with attachments that do not reference a SIR number in the subject line or the body of the message, will be disregarded to prevent the spread of computer viruses.  
BASIS OF AWARD 
The Government intends to make award based on successful negotiation of price and conformance with solicitation terms and conditions to the offeror that is considered to be the lowest priced, responsible offer. The Government will evaluate the Offeror’s proposed prices for fairness and reasonableness. 
 
Thank you for your interest in our procurement opportunity.
